property_summary: For any non-empty recipient array and matching amounts, calling transfer never reverts and returns true.
C.transfer always returns true for any arrays with at least one element and any addresses/values.
For any non-empty and equal-length arrays, C.transfer returns true and does not revert.
C.transfer returns true and does not revert when called with exactly one to-address and one value, provided the out-of-bounds risk is avoided by making the target address C itself.
For any non-empty arrays of equal length, C.transfer returns true without reverting, regardless of the target addresses or values.
For a single transfer with a non-empty, equal-length arrays of length 1, transfer always returns true without reverting.
For any non-empty batch, transfer always returns true and, since it has no balance-changing logic of its own, it does not alter the total ETH held by the callee or the caller.
For any non-empty batch call, transfer returns true and does not change the ETH balance of c or the caller.
